title: One Extra Dimension Suffices for the Complete-Graph Squared-Stress
summary: Let all pairwise distances of an arbitrary configuration of points in $\mathbb{R}^{\ell}$ be known exactly. We prove that every second-order stationary point of the complete-graph squared-stress objective over configurations in $\mathbb{R}^{k}$ has zero residual whenever $k > \ell$. The result holds for every number of points, without a genericity assumption, and allows repeated points and degenerate ground-truth configurations.
